posts.title: Temporary trade-liberalisation measures applicable to Armenian products
posts.label: 🤝 Provisional deal between Parliament & Council confirmed
posts.summary: This proposal aims to temporarily reduce trade barriers on products from Armenia. The measure would seek to make it easier and cheaper to import Armenian goods into the EU market for a limited period.
posts.whatsNext: The deal is provisional: it still needs a plenary vote in Parliament and formal adoption by the Council. Although confirmation is expected, either institution can still decline.
